generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can inherit a valid readiness package from another target and mistake existence or internal consistency for current-target ownership.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Classify persisted artifacts once before terminal identity exists and never reclassify after identity changes or reconstruction.
trigger_signals: existing readiness package on a derived branch
target identity added after controller initialization
generalized_learning.reusable_control: HANDOFF-TARGET-BINDING-001 performs semantic target classification before reuse and again at terminal handoff.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Reclassify persisted delivery artifacts whenever target identity changes and after rebuilding or publishing; never inherit cumulative audit state from a proven foreign material parent.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail closed unless the published package classifies as current-target; before result-child lineage checks, classify the material-parent audit package and allow lineage bypass only for proven foreign-target state.

transfer_cases.scenario: A target identifier becomes known after initialization and stale reuse must be invalidated.
A connector workspace starts with inherited artifacts and rebuilt bytes become current only after current subject binding.
A result-only child overwrites cumulative audit paths whose material parent belongs to another target; foreign lineage must not be inherited while same-target lineage remains protected.

skill_changes.change: Reclassification on identity refresh and after reconstruction.
Terminal gate requires current-target classification and foreign-vs-current material-parent lineage discrimination.
